repos.name: yakuikai/tokentab
repos.description: Local-first CLI and web dashboard that reads Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI session logs and shows token usage and cost by model, project, day and activity. No account, no API key, nothing leaves your machine
repos.one_liner: A privacy-focused local dashboard for tracking LLM token usage and costs across various CLI tools.
bullets: Built as a local-first CLI and web dashboard using Python.
Parses session logs from Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI to calculate granular costs.
Ensures data privacy by keeping all usage metrics and logs strictly on the local machine.
Ideal for developers and quant researchers monitoring LLM API spend without third-party tracking.

repos.name: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
repos.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 Muse Spark 1.3、MiMo V2.6 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
repos.one_liner: A plugin for dsh that provides free, unlimited access to frontier AI models without requiring API keys or logins.
bullets: JavaScript-based plugin architecture designed for seamless integration into the dsh environment.
Provides direct access to advanced models like Muse Spark 1.3 and MiMo V2.6.
Eliminates friction by removing the need for account registration or API key management.
Useful for rapid prototyping and testing high-end AI models in a zero-cost, zero-setup workflow.

repos.name: Caho1/open-claude-ui
repos.description: 基于 REA 深度拆解并高保真还原 Claude 官方桌面端 UI。纯手写 30 个独立 React 组件与 8 项硬核交互物理算法，附带 3000+ 行逆向分析手册。
repos.one_liner: A high-fidelity React-based recreation of the official Claude desktop UI, complete with reverse-engineered interaction logic.
bullets: Developed using TypeScript and React with 30 independent, modular components.
Features custom-built physics algorithms to replicate the specific feel of the Claude interface.
Includes a 3000+ line reverse-engineering manual detailing the UI/UX architecture.
Serves as a reference implementation for developers building complex, agentic AI interfaces.

repos.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
repos.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
repos.one_liner: A utility designed to improve the quality of AI-generated content by filtering out generic or 'slop' outputs.
bullets: JavaScript-based logic layer that acts as a quality-control filter for LLM prompts and responses.
Focuses on stylistic refinement to ensure AI output aligns with higher aesthetic or professional standards.
Addresses the common issue of 'generic slop' in automated content generation pipelines.
Applicable for automated marketing, creative writing, and high-quality synthetic data generation.

repos.name: Saffsanity/sill
repos.description: Any window from your Mac, live on your iPhone or iPad. Touch, Apple Pencil, trackpad and keys. Free, open source, no servers.
repos.one_liner: A zero-server, open-source utility for streaming Mac windows to iOS/iPadOS devices with full input support.
bullets: Built with Swift for native performance and low-latency screen sharing.
Supports bidirectional input including Apple Pencil, trackpad, and keyboard integration.
Operates entirely peer-to-peer without the need for external servers or cloud infrastructure.
Valuable for power users and developers needing a portable, secure secondary display for terminal or IDE workflows.
repos.img_alt: "Your Mac, on your iPad." The Mac's Weather app on an iPad held sideways, under Sill's bar of window thumbnails and buttons.
repos.img2_alt: "Laptop mode." An iPad held upright, with the Mac's Clock app on top and Sill's bar, a row of keys and a trackpad below it.
